summary: M07 implements the amended book/retention contract, scoped masked policy views, anchored payments, dues and Today contributors, serialized lifecycle and import operations, restart-safe PostgreSQL storage, renewal opportunities and commission handoff. Identified lifecycle insured/survival omissions, race windows, preview-validation omissions, normalized gross parsing, permission controls, stale-target display and version-header defects were corrected and verified in source and meaningful tests. Remaining concerns are PostgreSQL query/write scaling and approved future scheduler/M09/M12 integration seams.

findings.summary: `const rows = (await this.all(tx)).filter((p) => matchesPolicy(p.props, filter))` reads the tenant book before applying pagination. Correct scoped behavior is verified, but large books repeatedly load all policies; push filtering/paging into SQL when scaling the module.

`delete from book_import_row where batch_id=$1` followed by reinserting all rows makes every mapping/decision/chunk rewrite the batch.200-row commit transactions are bounded in policy creation but batch-row persistence still scales with total upload size.

Amended LLD explicitly defers production daily-job scheduling, the real M09 issued-policy producer and M12 reminder dispatch. Lifecycle/renewal methods and reader seam are tested; UI explains reminder availability.
